title: Beautiful Seville
text: This tour was a great way to see the Palace, Cathedral and Bell Tower. Mary was an excellent guide, very knowledgeable.  Definitely worth walking up the Bell Tower. Spectacular views of Seville.
author: G5181PAdeannag

title: Seville Palace and Cathedral
text: The tour showed us the beautiful Palace, Cathedral and the Bell Tower. I definitely recommend walking up the Bell Tower for a spectacular view of Seville.
author: Deanna_G

title: History, Beauty, and Great Storytelling
text: What an amazing experience! The combination of the Cathedral, Giralda, and Alcázar is simply unbeatable — rich history, incredible architecture, and lush gardens. The guide was friendly and professional, with a great sense of humor and deep knowledge of Andalusian heritage. We especially loved learning about the mix of Christian and Moorish influences. This tour is a must-do in Seville if you want more than just beautiful photos — you’ll walk away with a real connection to the city's history.
author: 706janetteu

title: This tour has a lot of...
text: This tour has a lot of history. Our guide was very knowledgeable and efficiently moved us through the two locations. Not a lot of pauses to get photos, but a lot of good information. I felt like we got a good overview of the two locations.
author: Tarryn_R
